channel.title: RideMeme Digest — Philippine & world motoring
channel.description: The day's top Philippine and world motoring stories, auto-curated.

item.title: VF 3 Wins Consumer Award
item.description: VinFast’s VF 3 has received the “Trusted & Popular Brand 2026” award in the Passenger Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) category at the Disway Awards 2026 in Indonesia, after recording the highest consumer awareness in its category. item.title: Green SM doubles Sumatra presence
item.description: Electric taxi operator Green SM has expanded its operations in Indonesia with the launch of its service in Palembang, the second city in Sumatra to welcome the company after Bandar Lampung.

item.title: Vingroup taps Alstom for 200 metro trainsets
item.description: Vietnamese conglomerate Vingroup has signed an agreement with French rail manufacturer Alstom to acquire 200 metro trainsets and develop local train production as Hanoi prepares to expand its urban railway network.

item.title: Give the bus a break
item.description: One of the things I envy while driving along EDSA is watching buses pass long lines of cars in their dedicated lane. Their passengers get to keep moving while the rest of us crawl through traffic.

item.title: Jaguar debuts 1,000-PS Type 01
item.description: Jaguar has unveiled the Type 01 in New York, a four-door electric grand tourer that introduces a new generation of vehicles from the British luxury carmaker.

item.title: The car wash
item.description: Growing up, watching my dad work on the cars he loved during the weekends made me someone who appreciates the look of a finished product. I remember sitting in the garage, watching Dad and his mechanic friends treat each part of a car like a piece of jewelry.

item.description: The DS F3VER is based on the company's "Design Intelligence" approach and definitely looks the part

item.title: Chase Briscoe Holds off JGR Teammate in Closest Finish of NASCAR Season
item.description: Chase Briscoe beat his Joe Gibbs Racing teammate Christopher Bell to the line by 0.029 seconds, the closest margin of the season.

item.title: Modern Turbo-Four Muscle Cars Are Still Better Than Old V6-Powered Base Models
item.description: In MotorWeek's test of a 1993 Chevrolet Camaro V6, it did 0 to 60 mph in 8.8 seconds, over half a second slower than a Nissan Altima of the same model year.
